justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype wrappers for AccountId/TransactionId and a typed error enum cover the domain well, though the Account/Transaction internal structs are minimal and the Unbalanced variant uses a raw i64.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with three meaningfully distinguishing variants and no panics, but uses saturating_add silently instead of detecting overflow as a distinct error case.
justifications.api_ergonomics: The required derives are present and the surface is narrow, but there are no doc comments on any public item and no Default impl for Ledger.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with derives, HashMap, and map/Option chaining, though balance uses nested manual loops where iterator chains with flat_map/filter/sum would be more expressive.
